definitions.explanation: Movable partitions and openings in a building, including doors, sliding doors, windows, and screens. A collective term for the functional elements that open, close, or partition interior spaces.

examples.japanese: {建具|たてぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建具|たてぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧だ。
examples.english: All the fittings in this house are made of wood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧や⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧⟦といった→といった：19872_toitta⟧{建具|たてぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕切|しき}っている→仕切る：04666_shikiru⟧。
examples.english: In old Japanese houses, fittings such as fusuma and shoji partition the rooms.

notes:
A compound of {建|たて} (building, construction) and ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool, equipment). Refers collectively to doors, sliding doors, windows, shutters, and other movable elements that divide or enclose spaces in a building.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese architecture relies heavily on {建具|たてぐ} such as ⟦{襖|ふすま}→襖：03908_fusuma⟧ (opaque sliding doors), ⟦{障子|しょうじ}→障子：04201_shouji⟧ (paper sliding doors), and ⟦{雨戸|あまど}→雨戸：03996_amado⟧ (rain shutters). A {建具屋|たてぐや} (fittings craftsman) is a specialized trade.
